associations.rationale: The type directly computes the self-Ext1 of V_a as an n-dimensional complex vector space.
For distinct parameters, the type directly makes Ext1(V_a,V_b) subsingleton, expressing its vanishing.
For n greater than one, the type directly supplies an infinite pairwise nonisomorphic family of indecomposable B-modules.
The type directly gives the Jrep-family isomorphism criterion: the base parameter agrees and the extension parameter differs by a nonzero scalar.
The type directly classifies isomorphisms among split two-dimensional representations, up to exchanging the two one-dimensional factors.
For distinct characters, the type rules out an isomorphism between the displayed split representation and any Jrep, giving cross-family separation.
The type says every two-dimensional module has a one-dimensional submodule and quotient of the indicated forms; this is a prerequisite extension reduction, not the final classification.
The type directly puts every two-dimensional representation into either a split or Jrep normal form, stating the core classification.
